svg.title: Oitomi mark evidence ceiling
svg.desc: The Oitomi mark card explains that the accessible first-party evidence establishes the workshop name and an underside OITOMI mark on a current trivet, but does not establish a kettle-mark method, location, range, or verified complete-kettle pair.
svg.text: The readable source tells us less than a confident attribution would need.
Reading: Oitomi. This is a typeset name, not a copied impression.
A current Oitomi trivet page reports an underside OITOMI mark.
It does not establish a tetsubin mark, method, location, date range, or body context.
Kettle mark technique, location, and range are not established.
Confidence: uncertain for an isolated object.
Find the complete body, its construction, and a dated source before using a name as attribution.
